clauses.text: Commercially reasonable efforts to maintain 99.5% monthly uptime.
Processing only on documented instructions from the customer.
Liability capped at twelve months of fees.
Renews automatically unless ninety days notice is given.
Provider may appoint sub-processors and publish a list on its website.
Industry standard security measures appropriate to the provider's size.
Provider licensed to use Customer Data to train machine learning models.
Customer indemnifies the provider against claims arising from use of the service.
Provider may increase fees on thirty days notice.
Data deleted seven days after termination, export on request.
Customer Data is stored within the European Economic Area.

risk_flags.rationale: A ninety day notice window against a twelve month term commits the customer to another year on a single missed date.
Uncapped increases with no termination right allow unilateral repricing of a locked-in customer.
A twelve month fee cap carves out nothing for data breach or confidentiality.
The standard is unmeasurable and gives the customer nothing to audit against.
Service improvement licences are common in SaaS terms.
Customer indemnities for use of the service are standard.
A defined deletion window is good data hygiene.

citations.quote: shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim
initial term of this Agreement is twelve (12) months
perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide licence to use Customer Data
may increase the fees at any time on thirty (30) days written notice
the Provider shall maintain SOC 2 Type II certification throughout the term
